payload.walk:
EACH QUALITY SCENARIO WALKED THROUGH THE BASELINE. Verdicts: ADDRESSED (a named element carries it), AT-RISK (carried but with a condition that could fail), UNADDRESSED (nothing carries it). Evaluation, not verification — nothing here claims a test passed.

Q1 — GUIDANCE VOLUME IS VISIBLE (R15, usability). An agent receives a packet whose guidance is joined from many nodes; the packet reports its size.
  VERDICT: AT-RISK. CARRIED BY: E6 rules (F16 report-weight), decision se.adr-applies-to-becomes-a-selector.
  THE RISK, and it is measured rather than feared: probe P5 found ten ledger nodes carrying applicability and ZERO machine states, with the field's content written as prose for a person. So the volume that F16 reports is currently zero, and a size report on an empty join says nothing. The scenario is addressed structurally and unaddressed in practice until the migration lands.

Q2 — A NON-ANSWER IS DISTINGUISHABLE FROM AN ANSWER (R2, R10, R19).
  VERDICT: ADDRESSED. CARRIED BY: E4 answers, kept deliberately outside the retrieval elements so four lanes share one idea of a non-answer.
  EVIDENCE FROM THIS ITERATION rather than from argument: the failure this element prevents happened three times today — a promotion reporting '1 failing' without a name, a runner counting a crash as a failing test, a suite reporting success having run nothing.

Q3 — A SEARCH ANSWERS IN ONE CALL (R3, need N2, pass line: ONE call carrying the caller's requested surrounding lines).
  VERDICT: ADDRESSED. CARRIED BY: E1 tree search, and E2 for refs under the shared result contract.
  NOTE: this is the requirement a previous design 'satisfied' by returning locations only and minting a decision explaining why that was acceptable. The pass line now names the thing rather than the outcome, so no design can satisfy it by redefining it.

Q4 — A BAD CALL COSTS A REFUSAL, NOT A WRONG ANSWER (R8, R35).
  VERDICT: ADDRESSED. CARRIED BY: E4, with the absent-versus-explicitly-empty distinction that the first implementation got wrong in the other direction.

Q5 — THE OWNER CAN TELL COMPUTED FROM ASSERTED WITHOUT READING PROSE (R20, need N9).
  VERDICT: AT-RISK. CARRIED BY: E7 checks (F21), and F30 which refuses an origin label with no fact behind it.
  THE RISK: the number of checks E7 can actually compute is small today, and the honest ones DEFER. A distinction between computed and asserted is only valuable if the computed set is non-trivial; with two lints deferring on the items-are-prose blocker, most of a gate stays asserted. Structurally addressed, thin in practice, and the thinness has one cause.

Q6 — AN UNATTENDED RUN IS NEVER PARKED BY A CHECK (R17, need N7).
  VERDICT: ADDRESSED. CARRIED BY: E7 (F19 defer), decision se.adr-a-lint-decides-or-defers. Every check yields pass, fail or defer; none blocks awaiting input.

Q7 — THE RECORD SURVIVES CARELESSNESS (R22, R23, R24, need N8).
  VERDICT: ADDRESSED. CARRIED BY: E8 record, decision se.adr-the-hash-is-the-pointer-the-tag-is-the-name.
  AT-RISK SUB-CASE, named rather than folded in: the readable name travels only if the push setting is configured, and the setting is on the machine rather than in the repository. A fresh clone on another machine has it unset. E8 carries the mechanism; nothing carries the machine.

Q8 — A GATE CANNOT PASS WITHOUT ITS REVIEW (R30, need N10, goal G5).
  VERDICT: ADDRESSED, and the strongest-evidenced item in this walk. CARRIED BY: E9 (F32), decision se.adr-rounds-are-injected-at-the-compiler.
  EVIDENCE: the injection broke eight fixture-gate tests on landing, because the machine began refusing gate submissions without rounds. Refusal is the observable.

Q9 — A REJECTED CLAIM STAYS READABLE (R31, need N11).
  VERDICT: ADDRESSED. CARRIED BY: E9 (F33) into E8 (F31).
  EVIDENCE: superseded evidence was not merely retained but USED — this iteration's own gate read a superseded frame to recover the register it was judging against.

Q10 — A RETURNED PATH STAYS TRAVERSABLE (R31 third clause).
  VERDICT: AT-RISK, and I am refusing to call it addressed despite two fixes and five tests. CARRIED BY: E9 (F34).
  WHY AT-RISK: this property has failed twice in one day, in two different ways, and both failures were SILENT — no error, no escape, no legal move. The second failure was introduced by the fix for the first. Five tests now cover it, but the class of defect is 'the walk stops and nothing says so', and the evidence that we can reason about it correctly is poor. Downgrading it from addressed to at-risk is the honest verdict and it is what makes the fitness function below worth building.

Q11 — A CALL NEVER HANGS OR FLOODS (R28).
  VERDICT: ADDRESSED. CARRIED BY: E1 (F5 bound) with native timeout, result cap and per-line width.

Q12 — A READ IS CONTAINED IN THE ROOT IT NAMES (R29).
  VERDICT: ADDRESSED. CARRIED BY: E3 reach (F6).

Q13 — THE SHARED JUDGE IS THE SAME FOR EVERY AGENT (R33, tension T2).
  VERDICT: AT-RISK. CARRIED BY: E9 (F36), decision se.adr-engine-promotes-to-trunk.
  THE RISK: the property holds only while every engine change goes through the promotion. The promotion cannot promote a fix to itself, and that gap was crossed by hand twice today. Each hand-crossing is a moment when trunk's judge changed outside the discipline that guarantees this scenario.

Q14 — THE SYSTEM DOES NOT DISRUPT ITS OWN OPERATOR. Not derived from a requirement, and added here because the walk found it.
  VERDICT: UNADDRESSED BY THE REGISTER, fixed in the implementation this session. Every subprocess now hides its console window, enforced by a lint. The register has no requirement for it, and the owner reported it as bad enough to stop voice dictation working.
  RECORDED AS A GAP IN THE REGISTER, not as a defect in the baseline: no element owns 'the tool is unobtrusive while it runs', and nothing would have caught the regression before the owner did. The lint is the whole of the coverage.

SUMMARY: 8 addressed, 5 at-risk, 1 unaddressed-and-patched. Three of the five at-risk items share ONE cause — requirements, functions and items are prose rather than nodes, so the applicability join is empty, the computed set is thin, and two structural properties cannot be machine-checked. That is one blocker wearing three costumes, and it is owner-owned work.
payload.fitness_candidates:
MEASURABLE SCENARIOS THAT COULD BECOME AUTOMATED CHECKS AT M7. Ordered by value, with the cheap-and-decisive ones first.

FC1 — EVERY GATE IN THE MACHINE CARRIES ALL FOUR ROUNDS AS REQUIRED. (Q8)
  MEASURE: compile the machine; for each state of kind gate, assert the four field names are present and required.
  WHY FIRST: it is a property over the WHOLE machine rather than over one gate, it is trivially computable, and it is the iteration's central claim. It also catches the failure mode that produced this iteration — a rule that is true today and quietly stops being true when someone authors a gate a different way.

FC2 — A REOPEN LEAVES EVERY DOWNSTREAM GATE REACHABLE. (Q10)
  MEASURE: for a machine and an instance, reopening any state must leave every state in the cone reachable by some sequence of fills. Property-based rather than example-based: generate reopens across the real machine's states rather than testing the two shapes that already broke.
  WHY IT MATTERS MORE THAN ITS FIVE EXISTING TESTS: both live failures were shapes nobody thought to write a test for, and the second was introduced BY the fix for the first. Example tests encode the failures we have already had. This one would have caught both before either happened.

FC3 — A VERIFICATION RUN THAT EXECUTED NOTHING IS FAILED. (R34)
  MEASURE: assert that a suite result of zero passed and zero failed is reported as failure by the promotion path.
  WHY: it already exists as a test; the fitness framing is that it should be asserted wherever a run result is INTERPRETED, not only where it is produced.

FC4 — NO SPAWN CAN POP A CONSOLE WINDOW. (Q14)
  MEASURE: already built and already earning — it caught the one call site the hand sweep missed, which was the most frequently called of all.
  NOTE AS THE PATTERN WORTH GENERALISING: this is a check over SOURCE rather than over behaviour, it took minutes, and it converts a property that depends on everyone remembering into one that depends on nothing.

FC5 — EVERY FUNCTION IS ALLOCATED EXACTLY ONCE, AND EVERY INTERFACE IS DECLARED AT BOTH ENDS.
  MEASURE: column and symmetry properties over the allocation and element matrices.
  BLOCKED, and this is the third appearance of one blocker: functions and elements are prose in evidence files, not nodes. Recorded as a candidate rather than a plan, because pretending it is available would be the false-pass this iteration exists to prevent.

FC6 — EVERY REQUIREMENT HAS A VERIFY METHOD, AND EVERY GATE FIELD IS FILLED.
  MEASURE: register scan. BLOCKED by the same cause as FC5 for the first half; the second half is computable today.

FC7 — NO CLAIM CONTRADICTS A RECORDED DECISION. (from the risk minted at M5)
  MEASURE: hard, and worth stating as an aspiration rather than a plan. The incident that motivates it — a rewalk contradicting a decision the same iteration had recorded two hours earlier — suggests a weaker but achievable version: when an evidence field asserts a property of a named tool or mechanism, surface the decisions that mention it. That is retrieval, not judgement, and retrieval is what E6 already does.

NOT A FITNESS CANDIDATE, and named so its absence is deliberate: 'the red-team round is sincere'. It constrains form, not sincerity. Any check for it would measure the presence of words, which is precisely the unearned mechanical label that Q5's own requirement forbids.
